description.value: Kokomo is a fully plant-based eatery with four Metro Vancouver locations, including this Port Moody outpost on Brew St. The menu centres on nourishing bowls, salads, acai bowls, and smoothies made with ingredients like marinated tempeh, gochujang tofu, and house-made granola. It's a bright, food-forward stop well-suited to cyclists seeking a substantial, entirely vegan meal after a ride.
